paragraphs.source_en: The ShoppingList Test The classic test for line extension is the shopping list. Just list the brands you want to buy on a piece of paper and send your spouse to the supermarket: Kleenex, Crest, Listerine, Life Savers, Bayer and Dial. That's easy enough. Most husbands or wives would come back with Kleenex tissue, Crest toothpaste, Listerine mouthwash, Life Savers candy, Bayer aspirin and Dial soap. Line extensions like Kleenex towels, Life Savers gum, Bayer nonaspirin and Dial antiperspirants have not destroyed the brands' original positions. Yet. But give them enough time to hang themselves.
